mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kayle has stopped Aatrox. Her Divine Judgment Cooldown is now reduced by 10 seconds and is visually larger.

“You will find no absolution in my judgment!”

Take down Aatrox twice before he can do the same to Kayle. An ally Morgana can aid her, but if Aatrox kills Morgana, he'll creep closer to victory. Kayle's Ultimate Ability, Divine Judgment, will improve upon besting him.

“Justice has vanquished Aatrox before. It is time again for him to writhe in its righteous flames!”

Kindred has ushered Tryndamere into the next realm, earning a bonus stack of their Passive Ability, Mark of the Kindred.

Lamb: “He still had much to live for...“
Wolf: “Those are the ones who give the best chase, little Lamb.”

Those meddlesome sisters have thwarted Aatrox's ruinous ambitions. Their false peace is all that remains.

“They cannot hold off the inevitable forever!”
This unit's next attack is ranged and deals bonus damage to low health enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kayle's attacks rank up as she gains levels and spends skill points.

  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank0@ - Zealous: Attacks grant @EnrageTotalASPerStack@% Attack Speed for @EnrageDuration@ seconds (max 5 stacks). At max stacks Kayle becomes Exalted, gaining @MSTowardsEnemy*100@% Move Speed.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank1@ - Arisen: Attack range is increased to @UpgradedAttackRange@.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank2@ - Aflame: Exalted attacks launch fire waves that deal @PassiveWaveDamage@ magic damage.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank3@ - Transcendent: Become permanently Exalted. Attack range is increased to @FinalAttackRange@.
